name: fip
title: FIP
description: Listen to FIP and its webradios, and see what they are playing, directly from Raycast
author: louison

commands.name: now
commands.title: Currently Playing Track
commands.subtitle: FIP
commands.description: Show the track currently playing on the last FIP radio you started

commands.name: prev
commands.title: Previous Track
commands.subtitle: FIP
commands.description: Show the track played before the current one on the last FIP radio you started

commands.name: next
commands.title: Next Track
commands.subtitle: FIP
commands.description: Show the next track announced on the last FIP radio you started

commands.name: start
commands.title: Start Playing
commands.subtitle: FIP
commands.description: Play your default FIP radio in your default player

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Playing
commands.subtitle: FIP
commands.description: Stop the FIP radio stream in your default player

commands.name: choose_radio
commands.title: Choose Radio
commands.subtitle: FIP
commands.description: Pick FIP or one of its webradios and start playing it

preferences.name: defaultApp
preferences.description: The app that plays the radio stream
preferences.title: Default Player

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
